title: Home guide: ice and a stone in water
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Muscles and bones (7C); the particle model (7G)
source: Written for science/y7 lesson 28 (Home practical guide and safety card: ice and stone in water (portal worksheet))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

practical.aim: Use the particle model to explain floating and sinking.
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Put an ice cube in one glass of water.
Put a small stone in the other.
Observe which floats and which sinks.
Explain using density and particles: in ice, water particles are held further apart than in liquid water.
